data.content: Implemented guarded lease-death recovery. Explicit termination and lazy expiry fail the interrupted step, clear only the matching binding, and return the knot to its profile queue; claim setup failures compensate to the queue; managed skills teach fresh-lease reclaim and stop on a new active owner. Branch: codex/lease-death-requeue. Commit: bf448a9e72b9. make lint, all tests, changeset/version checks, and 95.01% coverage pass.
